Originally from Lima, Peru, Dr. Vicuña earned his Doctor of Dental Surgery degree from The Ohio State University after completing his BS in Biology and Chemistry at the University of New Mexico. He is a proud member of the American Dental Association and Academy of General Dentistry. Since opening his own practice in 2005, Dr. Vicuña has been the sole dentist, allowing patients to build a personal relationship and receive truly individualized care.

extractions.title: Extractions
extractions.description: Extractions involve the removal of a tooth from its socket in the bone. This procedure may be necessary due to tooth decay, damage, or overcrowding.

fillings.title: Fillings
fillings.description: Fillings are used to restore a tooth damaged by decay. The dentist removes the decayed portion of the tooth and fills it with a material that matches your tooth color.

crowns.title: Crowns
crowns.description: Crowns are custom-made caps placed over damaged teeth to restore their shape, size, and strength while improving appearance.

rootCanals.title: Root Canals
rootCanals.description: A root canal is a treatment used to repair and save a tooth that is badly decayed or infected. It involves removing the damaged tissue inside the tooth.

wisdomTeeth.title: Wisdom Teeth
wisdomTeeth.description: Wisdom teeth extraction is a common procedure to remove one or more of the four third molars, which can cause pain or dental issues.

bleaching.title: Bleaching
bleaching.description: Teeth whitening or bleaching is a cosmetic procedure that brightens teeth using safe bleaching agents to enhance your smile.

dentures.title: Dentures
dentures.description: Dentures are removable replacements for missing teeth and surrounding tissues, available as complete or partial dentures.

partials.title: Partials
partials.description: Partial dentures are used when some natural teeth remain. They help fill in the spaces created by missing teeth and prevent other teeth from shifting.

dentureRepair.title: Denture Repair
dentureRepair.description: Denture repair services fix broken or damaged dentures, restoring functionality and appearance for comfortable use.

bridges.title: Bridges
bridges.description: A dental bridge is used to replace one or more missing teeth by anchoring them to adjacent teeth for support.

veneers.title: Veneers
veneers.description: Veneers are thin shells of porcelain or composite resin that cover the front surface of teeth to improve their appearance.

implants.title: Implants
implants.description: Dental implants are artificial tooth roots placed into the jawbone to support replacement teeth, providing a permanent solution for missing teeth.

firstAppointment.title: First Appointment
firstAppointment.arriveEarly: Do I need to arrive early for my first appointment?
firstAppointment.arriveEarlyAnswer: If you haven't filled out our online downloadable medical history and patient registration forms, please arrive 10-15 minutes early to do so. Download our forms by going to the forms page.
firstAppointment.preMedication: What should I do if I require pre-medication?
firstAppointment.preMedicationAnswer: Please be sure to request a prescription prior to your appointment, or if you are unsure, contact us and we can help.
firstAppointment.bring: What should I bring to my first appointment?
firstAppointment.bringAnswer: Please bring the following items with you to your appointment:
firstAppointment.bringItem4: Identification such as Driver's License, Military ID or State ID
firstAppointment.duration: How long will my first appointment last?
firstAppointment.durationAnswer: It varies, but please plan on spending 30 minutes to an hour for your first visit. We make it a point to clearly explain the benefits and fees for each treatment beforehand during our initial meeting.

preventiveDentistry.title: Preventive Dentistry
preventiveDentistry.healthyTeeth: What can I do to keep my teeth healthy?
preventiveDentistry.healthyTeethAnswer: Regular dental check-ups and cleanings, a balanced diet, and proper oral hygiene practices are essential.
preventiveDentistry.toothpasteAnswer: The most important ingredient to look for when choosing toothpaste is fluoride, which helps protect your teeth from decay.
preventiveDentistry.flossing: Why should I floss? Isn't brushing enough?
preventiveDentistry.flossingAnswer: Flossing removes plaque from between your teeth where a toothbrush can't reach, helping prevent gum disease and cavities.
preventiveDentistry.preventCavitiesItem1: Brush your teeth twice a day for at least two minutes.
preventiveDentistry.preventCavitiesItem3: Visit your dentist regularly for cleanings and check-ups.

generalDentistry.title: General Dentistry
generalDentistry.visitFrequency: How often do I need to visit the dentist?
generalDentistry.visitFrequencyAnswer: Most people should see their dentist twice a year, but those with specific dental concerns may need more frequent visits.
generalDentistry.xraySafetyAnswer: Dental x-rays are very safe and expose you to very low levels of radiation.
generalDentistry.sensitiveTeeth: What can I do about sensitive teeth?
generalDentistry.sensitiveTeethAnswer: Use sensitivity toothpaste and avoid highly acidic foods. If sensitivity persists, consult your dentist for tailored advice.

familyDentistry.title: Family Dentistry
familyDentistry.firstCheckup: When should I take my child to the dentist for their first check-up?
familyDentistry.firstCheckupAnswer: Your child should see a pediatric dentist between 6-9 months or no later than their first birthday.
familyDentistry.pregnancy: What happens if a woman has a dental problem when she is pregnant?
familyDentistry.pregnancyAnswer: Preventive dental cleanings during pregnancy are safe and recommended to avoid complications.

cosmeticDentistry.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
cosmeticDentistry.changeShape: I'm interested in changing the shape of my teeth. What options are available?
cosmeticDentistry.changeShapeAnswer: Options include bonding, crowns, veneers, and re-contouring.
cosmeticDentistry.whitening: What are my options for whitening my teeth?
cosmeticDentistry.whiteningAnswer: Consider whitening toothpastes or in-office bleaching after consulting with your dentist.

emergencies.title: Emergencies
emergencies.knockedOut: What if my tooth gets knocked out in an accident?
emergencies.knockedOutAnswer: Locate the tooth and rinse it gently. Place it in milk or saliva and seek dental care immediately.
emergencies.dentalEmergency: What should I do if I have a dental emergency and can't get a hold of my dentist?
emergencies.dentalEmergencyAnswer: If unable to reach your dentist, visit the nearest urgent care or emergency room for assistance.
